title: 进程三态状态机：每次转换的触发条件
expected_output:
进程: P1(服务4s,无I/O), P2(服务3s,第1s请求I/O), P3(服务2s,无I/O)，时间片 q=3

--- 状态转换日志 ---
  t=0  P1: 新建 -> 就绪  (被接纳)
  t=0  P2: 新建 -> 就绪  (被接纳)
  t=0  P3: 新建 -> 就绪  (被接纳)

判据总结:
  运行 -> 阻塞: 进程主动发起（请求 I/O / P 操作失败）
  阻塞 -> 就绪: 被动（I/O 完成后由中断处理程序唤醒，进程无法唤醒自己）
  运行 -> 就绪: 被抢占（时间片到 / 更高优先级进程到达）
  就绪 -> 运行: 被调度程序选中
code:
NEW, READY, RUN, BLOCK, TERM = "新建", "就绪", "运行", "阻塞", "终止"

class Process:
    def __init__(self, pid, service, io_at):
        self.pid = pid
        self.service = service
        self.io_at = io_at          # 运行到第几秒时发起 I/O 请求
        self.state = NEW
        self.used = 0

class Scheduler:
    def __init__(self, procs, quantum=3):
        self.procs = procs
        self.q = quantum
        self.ready = []
        self.blocked = []
        self.log = []
        self.now = 0

    def transit(self, p, to, reason):
        self.log.append("t=%d  %s: %s -> %s  (%s)" % (self.now, p.pid, p.state, to, reason))
        p.state = to

    def run(self):
        for p in self.procs:
            self.transit(p, READY, "被接纳")

        while any(p.state != TERM for p in self.procs):
            if not self.ready:
                # 推进 I/O：阻塞进程完成
                if self.blocked:
                    p = self.blocked.pop(0)
                    self.transit(p, READY, "I/O 完成（被动唤醒）")
                else:
                    break
                continue
            p = self.ready.pop(0)
            self.transit(p, RUN, "被调度程序选中")
            tick = 0
            while tick < self.q and p.used < p.service:
                if p.io_at is not None and p.used == p.io_at:
                    self.now += 1
                    p.used += 1
                    self.transit(p, BLOCK, "主动请求 I/O（运行->阻塞是主动的）")
                    self.blocked.append(p)
                    break
                tick += 1
                p.used += 1
                self.now += 1
            else:
                if p.used >= p.service:
                    self.transit(p, TERM, "运行结束")
                else:
                    self.transit(p, READY, "时间片到（被抢占）")
                    self.ready.append(p)
                continue
            # I/O 完成后继续循环
            if self.blocked and not self.ready:
                q = self.blocked.pop(0)
                self.transit(q, READY, "I/O 完成（被动唤醒）")
        return self.log


procs = [Process("P1", 4, None), Process("P2", 3, 1), Process("P3", 2, None)]
sched = Scheduler(procs, quantum=3)
log = sched.run()
print("进程: P1(服务4s,无I/O), P2(服务3s,第1s请求I/O), P3(服务2s,无I/O)，时间片 q=3")
print("")
print("--- 状态转换日志 ---")
for line in log:
    print("  " + line)
print("")
print("判据总结:")
print("  运行 -> 阻塞: 进程主动发起（请求 I/O / P 操作失败）")
print("  阻塞 -> 就绪: 被动（I/O 完成后由中断处理程序唤醒，进程无法唤醒自己）")
print("  运行 -> 就绪: 被抢占（时间片到 / 更高优先级进程到达）")
print("  就绪 -> 运行: 被调度程序选中")
